exposure: Spontaneous vaginal delivery (SVD) vs. unplanned operative delivery (UOD)
Nulliparous women at 37.0-42.0 weeks of gestation (n=234)
outcome: Unplanned operative delivery (vacuum-assisted, forceps-assisted and cesarean deliveries)
cohort: 234 nulliparous women at 37.0-42.0 weeks of gestation
finding: Maternal height, pubic arch angle, angle of progression, and estimated fetal weight, when assessed together, can improve the prediction of unplanned operative deliveries in nulliparous women.
mod_finding: Sonographic parameters of maternal pelvic configuration and maternal-fetal interface improved the prediction of unplanned operative deliveries, including cesarean deliveries.
